info.title: curiosity-cli
info.description: The official .NET command line tool for Curiosity Studio (https://curiosity.ai).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Interact with a Curiosity Studio workspace

commands.name: audit-log-template
commands.description: Print the default convert-audit-log template and the fields a template can use

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: convert-audit-log
commands.description: Convert audit log files to CSV, TSV, JSON Lines or JSON, following a column template

options.name: --template
options.description: Path to a template file describing the output columns (see audit-log-template). Default: every field

options.name: --output
options.description: Path of the file to write. Default: standard output

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: csv, tsv, jsonl or json. Overrides the template's @format; default from the output file's extension, else csv

options.name: --verify
options.description: Verify the hash chain first, and convert nothing if any file was tampered with

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: ARGS
arguments.description: Audit log files (.jsonl, or the .log configuration logs), folders holding them, or a wildcard such as ./audit/2026-09-*.jsonl

commands.name: download-audit-logs
commands.description: Download the audit log files from a workspace into a folder, skipping the files already there with the same length

options.name: --server

options.name: --token
options.description: Library Token, can be created on the workspace under Manage > Tokens > Library. The token can also be encrypted and stored locally with the store-token tool.

options.name: --from
options.description: First day to download, as yyyy-MM-dd (inclusive). Default: no lower bound

options.name: --to
options.description: Last day to download, as yyyy-MM-dd (inclusive). Default: no upper bound

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Timeout for requests in seconds. (default: 90 secs) [default: 90]

options.name: --help

commands.name: ingest-pst
commands.description: Upload emails extracted from a PST file

options.name: --server
options.description: URL to reach the workspace, such as 'https://my-workspace.curiosity.ai/'.

options.name: --token
options.description: Library Token, can be created on the workspace under Manage > Tokens > Library. The token can also be encrypted and stored locally with the store-token tool.

options.name: --path
options.description: PST file to analyze and upload emails from to the workspace

options.name: --bandwidth
options.description: Maximum Bandwith in Mbps

options.name: --source
options.description: Name of the source, to be added to each file entry. The default is the file name of the specified file.

options.name: --upload-to
options.description: Where to store the file. Possible values are: Public, Group, UserPublic or UserPrivate [default: Public]

options.name: --target-uid
options.description: If you pass Group or UserPublic/UserPrivate to the --upload-to parameter, you need to also specify the UID of the Group/User

options.name: --ignore-folders
options.description: A semicolon (';') delimited list of case-sensitive folder names to skip (including any sub folders) - if not specified then a default set will be used but this may not cover all folders that should be bypassed if the folder names are translated into different languages

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Timeout for requests in seconds. (default: 90 secs) [default: 90]

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: monitor
commands.description: Monitor and sync a folder to the workspace

options.name: --server
options.description: URL to reach the workspace, such as 'https://my-workspace.curiosity.ai/'.

options.name: --token
options.description: Library Token, can be created on the workspace under Manage > Tokens > Library. The token can also be encrypted and stored locally with the store-token tool.

options.name: --path
options.description: Folder to monitor and sync to the workspace

options.name: --bandwidth
options.description: Maximum Bandwith in Mbps

options.name: --fetch-server-state
options.description: Fetch the already synchronized files before starting a sync. This is required to make sure that locally deleted files which are also deleted from the workspace. Requires syncFileUrl

options.name: --restore-access-time
options.description: Restore last access date after reading file (only recomended for hot+cold storage network drives)

options.name: --source
options.description: Name of the source, to be added to each file entry. The default is the name of the directory of the given Path.

options.name: --upload-to
options.description: Where to store the file. Possible values are: Public, Group, UserPublic or UserPrivate [default: Public]

options.name: --target-uid
options.description: If you pass Group or UserPublic/UserPrivate to the --upload-to parameter, you need to also specify the UID of the Group/User

options.name: --extensions
options.description: Extensions to upload, split by ';' - example: --extensions doc;docx;pdf;

options.name: --root-path
options.description: Name of the root Path to be replaced by the root-folder-name in the workspace.

options.name: --root-folder-name
options.description: Name of the root folder created in the workspace. If none is given, the folders are created under the workspace root folder.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Timeout for requests in seconds. (default: 90 secs) [default: 90]

options.name: --sync-file-url
options.description: Sync the file url to the workspace. Uploaded files then can be opened directly.

options.name: --in-place
options.description: ONLY Sync the file url to the workspace. Uploaded files then can be opened directly. The server needs direct access to the files to make them searchable. No files are copied.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Serve locally a front-end project built with the Mosaik.FrontEnd nuget package

options.name: --server
options.description: URL to reach the workspace, such as 'https://my-workspace.curiosity.ai/'.

options.name: --path
options.description: Path to output folder from the compiled front-end. Example .\MyProject\bin\Debug\netstandard2.0\h5\

options.name: --name
options.description: Name of the app, to be shown for example on the navbar of the UI [default: Mosaik]

options.name: --ignore-certificate-errors
options.description: Ignore certificate errors

options.name: --port
options.description: Port to bind locally [default: 5000]

options.name: --cert-file
options.description: Certificate file to bind, only required if binding to https

options.name: --cert-password
options.description: Certificate file password, only required if binding to https and if certificate is password protected

options.name: --listen-to-any
options.description: Pass if you would like to list to connections from any IP, instead of only connections from localhost

options.name: --enable-cors
options.description: Enable CORS on local hosting

options.name: --path-base
options.description: Base path to listen, default to none

options.name: --watch
options.description: Path to a Transpose front-end project (.csproj, or the folder holding one) to compile and keep watching. The compiled site is what gets served, so -p/--path is not needed, and the browser reloads itself after every rebuild.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build configuration for --watch (default: Debug). [default: Debug]

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: upload-front-end-source
commands.description: Upload the source code of a front-end project to the workspace's front-end repository and trigger its compilation

options.name: --server
options.description: URL to reach the workspace, such as 'https://my-workspace.curiosity.ai/'.

options.name: --token
options.description: Library Token, can be created on the workspace under Manage > Tokens > Library. The token can also be encrypted and stored locally with the store-token tool.

options.name: --path
options.description: Path to the front-end project folder (the one holding its .csproj). Defaults to the current folder. bin, obj, .git, .vs, .idea and node_modules are not uploaded.

options.name: --branch
options.description: Existing branch of the workspace's front-end repository to commit to. Defaults to the branch the workspace publishes from, in which case the live front-end is replaced once the build succeeds.

options.name: --new-branch
options.description: Commit to a new branch instead, started from the branch the workspace publishes from. Fails if the branch already exists. The build is not published.

options.name: --message
options.description: Commit message for the upload

options.description: Ignore certificate errors
